shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x, no power link, rotatable edge-hugging), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, ground car holds both links, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side, no refund; reinstall spawns fresh). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops.
- All consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC.
- Mounted riders (Giddy-Up) are blocked from stairs jobs with a dismount message (job start + transfer backstop); mounts carrying riders are skipped by the pet follow pull.

## Systems (T0-T10 all verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- See-below renderer: whitelisted layers incl. water depth, air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45), silhouettes suppressed, ceiling hints, far clip 70.
- Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch WorkGiver + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls with aggregated alternatives, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery after transfer.
- Needs: rest routes to owned bed anywhere in column (two-hop) or free bed on linked level; food redirect for colonists and eligible pets.
- Medical/prisoners: cross-level rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent continuations (land at exit, queued vanilla Rescue/Capture).
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (+ ghouls in Schedule only, Animals tab patched separately, Fluffy Animal Tab covered via its RecachePawns); colonist bar groups ordered sky/surface/basement per column; level view buttons in the vanilla global controls row (Declutter UI suppression bypassed); camera preserves precise sub-cell position and zoom; beds alert aggregates the column.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link (elevator second link included).
- Cross-map ordered work: ABPendingOrders stashes an action + target map, replayed by StairTransfer on arrival (job queues do not survive despawn).

## Performance architecture (2026-07-19 optimization pass)
- ABGuard kill switches are plain bool objects (ABGuardSwitch), not a string HashSet: hot gates pay one field read. Call sites unchanged (ABGuard.On(ABGuard.X)).
- LevelComp.AnySkyLevels: game-weakref-keyed static counter of live sky levels; the OutdoorTemp/SeasonalTemp getter postfixes (hottest patched surface) early out on static reads when no sky level exists.
- CrossLevelWork.NearestUsableStairsCached: per-tick (pawn, targetMap) memo over the reachability stairs search, negative results included. Used by all three CrossLevelHaul lookups so the HaulableEver scanner pays the region search twice per pawn-scan instead of once per candidate item.
- Shared helpers: TryResolveStairs / MakeStairsJob / TryStairsJobToward (previously duplicated 6x) and ABVirtualPosition.WithPawnAt for cold-path virtual scans; CrossLevelHaul.Check keeps its hand-written swap (hot).
- Small caches: Building_ABStairs.Ext (sentinel-flag mod-extension cache), static meal def array in CrossLevelDemand, cached level-button tooltip strings, shared ABIcons.
- Everything else already event-driven: LevelSync via MapEvents, ceiling layer on the Roofs mesh flag, colonist bar reorder on recache only, weather/climate/pipes staggered polling (150/250 ticks), power bridge 10-tick hash interval. Zero recurring cost with no levels built.

## Compat
- DBH water + VEF PipeSystem: equalization bridges, load-verified + DBH live-verified.
- Reverse Commands (brrainz.reversecommands): reversed float menu lists colonists from directly linked levels (virtual placement at stairwell exit, wrapped actions route through stairs, replay via ABPendingOrders, PathInfo cache seeded). Inert without the mod; needs a companion-mod test run.
- Fluffy Animal Tab (Fluffy.AnimalTab): its window replaces vanilla's and reads CurrentMap only; ABAnimalTabCompat postfixes its RecachePawns by reflection and appends other levels' colony animals, running extras through its own FilterWorkers. Fails open per pawn and per session.
- Declutter UI (sk.dmbb): its options can suppress foreign play-settings widgets; ABDeclutterCompat lifts MapControlsTableContext.SuppressExternal only while our two level buttons draw.
- Giddy-Up (all forks): mounted-rider stairs block, def-based detection (Mounted job targeting the rider), zero reflection. ABGiddyUpCompat.
- About.xml declares incompatibleWith telardo.MultiFloors and ZLevels1.1 (the other z-level mods).
- RimThreaded/FPS+: unsupported (cross-map event writes + virtual position swaps are not thread-safe against it); to be documented in the field manual.
- Foreign pocket maps (Dungeon Core, Camping Tent, Anomaly/Odyssey): read as standalone level-0 maps, all our behavior gates on links.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air (cosmetic); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples counted as singles in beds alert; Reverse Commands scope is directly linked levels only (two-hop pawns excluded); restaurants (Gastronomy) do not span levels.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE and verified in-game (2026-07-19). Optimization + compat pass (perf tiers 1-6, Animal Tab/Declutter/Giddy-Up compat) CODE DONE, build green - pending a companion-mod verification run (Reverse Commands + Animal Tab + Declutter UI + Giddy-Up + Performance Optimizer).
- Next: T5 publishing prep (field manual incl. RimThreaded note, Steam description + Quality Commitment block, Preview.png done, dependency audit, publish-hold, final regression with and without companions).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
All tranches through T10 verified. Optimization/compat pass applied and compiling; awaiting companion-mod test run, then T5 publishing prep.
